mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 branch_id FROM branch_managers_51 WHERE emp_id = #{empId} AND is_deleted = 'n'
SELECT region_type FROM branches_51 WHERE branch_id = #{branchId} AND is_deleted = 'n'

SELECT b.branch_id as branchId, b.branch_name as branchName, b.region_type as regionType, b.latitude as lat, b.longitude as lng, e.score as score, m.evaluatee_id as empId FROM branches_51 b JOIN branch_managers_51 bm ON b.branch_id = bm.branch_id JOIN evaluator_mappings_51 m ON bm.emp_id = m.evaluatee_id JOIN evaluations_51 e ON m.mapping_id = e.mapping_id WHERE m.period_id = #{periodId} AND m.relation_type_code = 'OPERATIONAL' AND b.is_deleted = 'n' AND m.is_deleted = 'n'
